## Description

Counsel writes the wording and uploads it; staff can only publish an approved version, never edit text. A new version can require every owner to accept again; until they do only online booking pauses, nothing clinical stops (the existing terms gate is reused). Acceptance is recorded with who, version and time.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a new version requires acceptance, when an owner has not accepted, then online booking pauses and clinical work continues.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given platform staff, when try to edit wording, then the console offers no edit, only publish.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an owner accepts, when it is saved, then user, version and time are recorded.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
